test_title: PYST 1: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Arrange the passage correctly:**
(1) She bought a book.
(2) She went to the store.
(3) She read the book.
(4) She really enjoyed the story.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct sequence of events is **2-1-3-4**, which logically arranges the passage in a meaningful order.
 
• **Sentence 2** is the first sentence as it sets the context by stating that she went to the store.
 
• **Sentence 1** follows because it describes the action she took at the store—buying a book.
 
• **Sentence 3** comes next, as it details what she did after buying the book—she read it.
 
• **Sentence 4** is the final sentence, as it reveals the result of her reading the book—she enjoyed the story.
 
• The logical progression of events is: she went to the store, bought a book, read the book, and then enjoyed the story.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Proper sequencing ensures coherence and clarity in the narrative flow.
 
• It is essential to identify the logical order of events by understanding their cause-effect relationship.
 
• In this case, the sequence begins with an action (going to the store), followed by subsequent actions (buying, reading, and enjoying the book).

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"She went to the store. She bought a book. She read the book. She really enjoyed the story."
3f:T
